name: Cleaner
source:
A grumpy and outspoken university cleaner who takes his job very seriously.
He often complains about students and their messes, but beneath his rough attitude he seems like a decent and good-natured man.
Experienced and observant, he also keeps an eye on the university after hours and knows more about what happens there at night than he lets on.
